title: Concept: Content security policy reports sent to a third party
description: A report-uri that points outside the bank's domains in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Report payloads include the blocked URL and sometimes the page, so the vendor learns which internal pages a customer visited and where the bank's own policy fails.
applicability: Deployments that render a report-uri that points outside the bank's domains into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Report payloads include the blocked URL and sometimes the page, so the vendor learns which internal pages a customer visited and where the bank's own policy fails.
